next.reason: 1985: "one greater than the final LINE-COUNTER setting established by the page footing report group"; 2023: "the line following the last line of the page footing, if specified, or ... adding 1 to the FOOTING integer, if no page footing is defined". 1985 counts PF's final LINE-COUNTER (after NEXT GROUP) when a PF was presented on the page; 2023 counts the PF's last line when one is defined. The HEADING case is the same.
